AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Kluvs is a book club app. A club reads one book at a time in its active session, and members meet at scheduled discussions for that session. Each member can RSVP to discussions, keep a private note per discussion, and log their reading progress on the club's current book. Operational patterns: - Clubs can be given by name (as the user says it) or ID, and discussions by title or ID. When omitted, functions use the user's only club with a current book, or the user's next upcoming discussion. - If the choice is ambiguous, the function fails with the matching options; ask the user which one they mean and call again with it. - Results name the club and discussion that were used; mention them to the user. - Use getDiscussionDetails to read a discussion's RSVPs and the user's existing note before changing either. - saveDiscussionNote replaces the whole note, so to add to an existing note, include its current text. Constraints: - Every function acts as the signed-in Kluvs user and only on clubs that user belongs to. - Only a club's owner or admins can create discussions; listMyClubs shows the user's role in each club.
